shell_commands: npm run prettier -- src/transport/messageHandler.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/testAcceptanceUtils.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/types/session.ts 2>&1 | head -30

git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(transport): implement list_sessions handler with history support (#144)

Add support for listing conversations over WebSocket protocol:
- Implement list_sessions message handling in messageHandler
- Thread sessionStore and history options through createServer to handler
- Return UNSUPPORTED error when history is disabled or store has no listFor
- Return SESSION_LIST with ISO string dates when successful
- Add UNSUPPORTED error code to ErrorCodes
- Extract common test utilities to eliminate code duplication
- Fix prefer-early-return and no-flag-params eslint violations
- Update tests to enable history where needed and verify correct error codes
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git log --oneline origin/main..HEAD
npm run eslint -- src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts 2>&1 | head -50
